page.title: Notes
page.purpose: Expose the removable notes example as a concrete route while the scenario's real product domain is still being shaped.

regions.purpose: Load the removable notes example and make its usable, empty, or failed state explicit to operators and automation.

states.description: Data for this surface is in flight; skeleton structure is shown rather than a blank frame.
No records exist yet for this surface; guidance names the action that creates the first one.
Some data resolved and some did not; what resolved stays usable and what failed is named rather than silently omitted.
Displayed data is known to be out of date relative to its source; the surface says so rather than presenting it as current.
The request failed; the specific cause is stated inline and the surface offers the action that retries it.
